name: Dharwad
scopeLimits: The official district portal links to Karnataka Revenue Maps and RTC services, but the map service page timed out locally during read-only inspection. The official page describes service categories, not a feature-level geometry API or schema. No parcel-specific search, login, or geometry request was made. The WUP point is a population-weighted settlement locator, not a parcel or city boundary. No owner/address/right-holder values, accounts or credentials were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Dharwad District land-records service page lists Revenue Maps, RTC/MR, and related land-record services and identifies a records section at the Dharwad Collectorate. This confirms local district land records and map indexing, but does not establish an anonymous full-vector cadastral service for the exact urban WUP locator.
